content: Krita stabilizer: averages tablet inputs and lags behind cursor; parameters are sample counts at max/min speed, delay (dead zone for sharp corners), finish line (complete the stroke on release), stabilize sensors (smooth pressure/speed/tilt), scalable distance (zoom-proportional). Weighted smoothing's stroke-ending option always draws a straight line. Clip Studio users report lag; Lazy Nezumi visualizes the pulled string. Tradeoff: more smoothing means more lag and lost stroke ends.
